office: Representative, Las Piñas City Lone District
role: District Representative · Las Piñas City, Lone District
profileLabel: Left-leaning economics (medium confidence); no other dimension scored
summary: Las Piñas representative with about 78 principal-authored bills. Authored a national unemployment insurance program, a universal social pension, a ban on labor-only contracting, salary transparency in job ads and housing loan help for solo parents. Co-authored a solidarity contribution on the most affluent and wage-increase bills. Also authored an anti-dynasty bill.
caveat: Economic score is capped at -3 because only bills, not votes or conduct, were reviewed. Anti-dynasty is a single issue, so democratic institutions is not scored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored national unemployment insurance and universal social pension (-3), ban on labor-only contracting and salary transparency (-3); co-authored solidarity contribution on the most affluent and wage increases (-3). Three issues, consistent redistributive direction, bill-based.
